subject.title: [Bug]: Real-time logs of openclaw cron jobs are not displayed in the chat session of the webui

question: Where should default or explicitly isolated cron run progress appear live in the Web UI: the run-scoped chat, the stable cron job chat, a separate follow/status surface, or only the existing final/run-log path?
rationale: Current code intentionally defaults agentTurn cron jobs to isolated run-scoped sessions while docs describe final delivery and polling, so automation should not pick the live-progress product contract unilaterally.

options.title: Live run-scoped watch surface
options.body: Define the run-scoped chat or watch view as the live destination, then route cron deltas there with dedupe/history tests and Control UI proof.

options.title: Document final-only delivery
options.body: Keep default isolated cron delivery completion-oriented and make the Cron runs/status surface the supported way to inspect progress or completion.

options.title: Mirror into stable cron chat
options.body: Route live isolated run progress into a stable cron job chat too, with explicit semantics for history, duplicate display, and overlapping runs.

recommendation.title: Live run-scoped watch surface
recommendation.body: Define the run-scoped chat or watch view as the live destination, then route cron deltas there with dedupe/history tests and Control UI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The latest merged cron session-target contract and older isolated cron seam history make steipete the clearest owner candidate for the product-direction choice.
